python -c 'import sys, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
root = ET.parse(sys.argv[1]).getroot()
if root.tag not in {"testsuite", "testsuites"}:
    raise SystemExit("Unexpected JUnit root")
suites = [root] if root.tag == "testsuite" else list(root.findall("testsuite"))
tests = sum(int(suite.attrib.get("tests", "0")) for suite in suites)
skipped = sum(int(suite.attrib.get("skipped", "0")) for suite in suites)
failures = sum(int(suite.attrib.get("failures", "0")) for suite in suites)
errors = sum(int(suite.attrib.get("errors", "0")) for suite in suites)
if tests != 103 or skipped != 0 or failures != 0 or errors != 0:
    print("Expected exactly 103 executed Pi0.5 CPU tests; "
          f"tests={tests}, skipped={skipped}, failures={failures}, errors={errors}", file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(5)
' "$$PI05_CPU_ARTIFACT_DIR/pytest.xml"

commands:

nodes=(
  "tests/diffusion/test_device_reduction.py::test_device_reduction_matches_a_float32_reference[dtype0]"

  "tests/diffusion/test_wan_device_reduction.py::test_wan_uint8_media_finalization_does_not_rescale"
  "tests/diffusion/test_wan_device_reduction.py::test_diffusion_output_to_cpu_moves_wan_media_off_device"
  "tests/diffusion/test_wan_device_reduction.py::test_small_typed_media_is_on_cpu_before_ipc"
  "tests/diffusion/test_wan_device_reduction.py::test_wan_float_media_finalization_matches_the_legacy_path"
  "tests/diffusion/test_wan_device_reduction.py::test_oom_fallback_media_packs_without_device_widening"
  "tests/diffusion/test_wan_device_reduction.py::test_oom_fallback_recovers_the_allocator"
  "tests/diffusion/test_wan_device_reduction.py::test_oom_fallback_releases_late_uint8_traceback_before_clone"
)

  tests/diffusion/test_device_reduction.py \

if [[ "$$status" -eq 0 ]]; then
  if python -c 'import sys, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; root = ET.parse(sys.argv[1]).getroot(); suites = [root] if root.tag == "testsuite" else list(root.findall("testsuite")); tests = sum(int(suite.attrib.get("tests", "0")) for suite in suites); skipped = sum(int(suite.attrib.get("skipped", "0")) for suite in suites); ok = tests == 17 and skipped == 0; print(f"Expected exactly 17 executed device-reduction GPU tests; reported tests={tests}, skipped={skipped}.", file=sys.stderr) if not ok else None; raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 5)' "$$ROCM_DEVICE_REDUCTION_ARTIFACT_DIR/pytest.xml"
  then
    status=0
  else
    status=$$?
  fi
fi
(exit "$$status")
